sections.subhead: High-Converting, Mobile-First Landing Pages Built for Paid Ads and Lead Generation

body.text: Teknoppy designs landing pages in Kochi for Google Ads, Meta and launch campaigns. Each page has one offer and one call to action, matches the ad's message, loads fast on mobile and comes with conversion tracking. Most pages are ready in 5-10 working days.

A standard website page cannot carry the weight of a paid ad campaign. Driving ad clicks to an open-ended homepage dilutes your conversion rate and raises your cost per lead. Every landing page we build is structured to keep visitors focused on a single conversion goal from headline to submission.

sections.h2: What Our Landing Page Service Includes

items.title: Distraction-Free Layout Architecture
items.text: We remove global navigation bars, multi-tier footer links, and off-topic buttons so visitors focus entirely on your value proposition and contact form.

items.title: Campaign-Specific Custom Development
items.text: Every page is designed from scratch around your specific offer and ad copy. We do not reuse generic templates, ensuring tight message match and higher Google Ads Quality Scores.

items.title: Mobile-First Speed & Performance
items.text: Over 75% of paid ad traffic in Kerala arrives via smartphones. We optimize every mobile element, ensuring sub-2-second load times, crisp typography, and thumb-friendly form inputs.

items.title: A/B Testing & Tracking Ready
items.text: We set up Google Tag Manager, GA4 event tracking, Meta Pixel, and Microsoft Clarity heatmaps, with layout variants ready for split-testing headlines and offers.

items.title: 1. Campaign & Offer Briefing (Day 1)
items.text: We analyze your target audience, ad platform, keyword intent, and the single conversion action you want visitors to take.

items.title: 2. Message Match Mapping (Days 2-3)
items.text: We match your landing page headline, subhead, and proof points to the exact ad copy and search queries to maximize ad Quality Score.

items.title: 3. Wireframe & Copy Draft (Days 4-5)
items.text: We craft persuasive sales copy and a single-column, conversion-focused wireframe with strategic trust badges and FAQs.

items.title: 4. Design & Build (Days 6-8)
items.text: We build the responsive page with clean code, compressed assets, and sub-second Core Web Vitals performance.

items.title: 5. Launch, Track & Optimise (Days 9-10)
items.text: We verify form submissions, connect webhooks to your CRM, test pixel tracking, and launch before ad campaigns go live.

items.q: How much does a landing page cost in Kochi?
items.a: A high-converting landing page at Teknoppy typically costs between ₹18,000 and ₹35,000, including custom UI design, conversion copywriting, mobile optimization, and full analytics tracking setup. Delivery takes 5 to 10 working days.

items.q: What makes a landing page convert?
items.a: High conversion relies on one clear offer, an impactful headline that matches your ad copy, social proof near the form, an uncluttered layout with no navigation distractions, fast mobile load speed, and a frictionless form.

items.q: What is a good landing page conversion rate?
items.a: While average website pages convert at 1-2%, dedicated landing pages typically achieve conversion rates between 4% and 12%, depending on the offer, industry competitiveness, and audience qualification.

items.q: Should my landing page appear in Google search?
items.a: Campaign-specific landing pages are usually set to 'noindex' so they don't compete with your organic SEO pages or present fragmented offers to casual searchers. However, evergreen lead generation pages can be fully optimized for organic ranking if desired.

items.q: Do I need a separate page for each Google Ads campaign?
items.a: Yes, ideally one per ad group or keyword theme. Sending different campaigns to one generic page lowers Quality Score and raises cost per lead, because the page no longer matches each ad's specific message. See our Google Ads Management Kochi services.

items.q: How long does landing page design take?
items.a: Most single landing pages are designed, coded, and tested within 5 to 10 working days, ensuring your campaign launches on schedule.

items.q: Will my landing page work with my existing ad accounts?
items.a: Yes. We configure Google Tag Manager, GA4 custom conversion events, and Meta Pixel events so conversions sync directly into your existing Google and Meta ad accounts from day one.

items.q: Do you also write the landing page copy?
items.a: Yes. Compelling conversion copywriting is included in our service. We craft headlines, value propositions, and calls to action in-house to match your brand tone and campaign objectives.
